newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zaire rebels say Kengo resignation changes nothing.
newsitem.headline: Zaire rebels say Kengo resignation changes nothing.

text.p: Zairean rebels said on Tuesday the resignation of Prime Minister Kengo wa Dondo made no difference to their demands for negotiations before a ceasefire.

"Kengo's resignation changes nothing. He was forced out by the same corrupt process that put him in place. We still want to talk to the man with power (President Mobutu Sese Seko)," said Raphael Nghenda, information commissioner in the rebel alliance.
Kengo resigned on Monday after Mobutu said he had taken note of a vote of censure against the prime minister by the transitional national assembly in Kinshasa following five months of rebel advances.
